verdict: Mixed: Fed rate hike slammed solar (FSLR -4%, ENPH -5%); optics complex surged (CIEN +8.9%, COHR +7%, LITE +7.8%); MRVL dual catalysts; SNDK S&P 100 inclusion Sept 21; no new DRAM/HBM pricing prints.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24-72h)

**Solar selloff — Fed hike catalyst (Sept 18-19).** First Federal Reserve rate hike in three years hit residential solar financing costs. FSLR fell ~4% to ~$193; ENPH dropped ~5% to $34.29. Sector pressure acute given elevated rates + tight tariff pre-deadline procurement window (Dec 4 effective date).

**Optics complex recovery (Sept 15-17).** After a brief selloff, CIEN surged +8.9% to $346.89; COHR +7.02% to ~$271; LITE +7.77% to ~$839. Ciena's fiscal Q3 print underpinned the move: revenue $1.67B (+37% YoY), cloud revenue +82% YoY (53% of total). Coherent announced POLS portfolio expansion Sept 17. Stifel raised price targets on all three names ahead of upcoming earnings.

**MRVL — dual catalysts (Sept 16-17).** GlobalFoundries + Marvell expanded SiGe capacity pact (Sept 16). Marvell + Microsoft + Utimaco launched Azure Payment HSM v2 (Sept 17), citing $5B cloud payment market; stock responded to the hyperscaler co-brand.

**SNDK — S&P 100 inclusion Sept 21.** SanDisk announced for S&P 100 addition; passive fund buying event. Stock ~$1,798, up ~574% YTD.

**HIVE Digital (Sept 17).** Rose ~3.9% on leadership appointment + AI infrastructure partnership announcement. Signals continued GPU/HPC pivot alongside crypto operations.

**TSLA (Sept 17).** +2.27% to $366 without a strong fundamental catalyst; Goldman Sachs cut Q3 delivery estimate to 435K (from ~459K). YTD -21%.

**RMBS.** Launched CryptoManager Root of Trust for AI/datacenter security — no large move noted but product line extension worth tracking.

**SaaS rotation.** NOW, ZS, CRM, SNOW caught a bid as investors rotated from AI hardware on deceleration signals — enterprise software acting as a relative haven.

## Signals (No Fresh Print)

- **DRAM/HBM pricing:** No new TrendForce QoQ print Sept 17-20. Last print Sept 2: server DRAM 3Q26 +13-18% QoQ — pace decelerating from 1Q26's +90-95% and 2Q26's +58-63%.
- **HBM4 ramp:** No new announcements. Trajectory: SK Hynix ~150-200K wfr/mo; Micron targeting 100K by year-end; Samsung HBM4 yields still low (~10%). No correction-phase news.
- **Hyperscaler capex:** No new prints. Combined top-4 still tracking ~$725B 2026 capex (+77% YoY). No guide-down detected.
- **AMD MI400/Helios:** No new Sept 17-20 news. AAI 2026 figures stand: $5.25M/rack, reported $12GW in orders.
- **Custom ASICs:** No new ASIC announcements. AWS/Qualcomm $60B deal (Sept 8) remains the last major item.

## Most Important Development

**The Federal Reserve rate hike (first in 3 years) is the macro wildcard this week.** It hits solar directly via financing costs but also signals a higher-for-longer regime that could re-price high-multiple AI hardware names. The optics complex recovery (led by a genuine Ciena earnings beat and Coherent product expansion) is the strongest positive signal of the week, confirming that photonics demand remains structurally intact despite macro noise.
